REQ-001 (patient, priority P1): The system shall support recurring appointments across all locations. Acceptance: reviewed by the privacy officer.
REQ-002 (receptionist, priority P1): The system shall support double-booking prevention across all locations. Acceptance: demonstrated to two pilot clinics.
REQ-003 (patient, priority P0): The system shall support patient reminders by SMS across all locations. Acceptance: covered by load tests at 10x normal volume.
REQ-004 (receptionist, priority P0): The system shall support room and equipment booking for up to 50 staff members. Acceptance: verified by an end-to-end test.
REQ-005 (receptionist, priority P0): The system shall support waiting list without data loss on reconnect. Acceptance: reviewed by the privacy officer.
REQ-006 (clinician, priority P1): The system shall support cancellation policy within 2 seconds. Acceptance: verified by an end-to-end test.
REQ-007 (receptionist, priority P2): The system shall support staff shift view for up to 50 staff members. Acceptance: reviewed by the privacy officer.
REQ-008 (admin, priority P2): The system shall support audit log for every action. Acceptance: covered by load tests at 10x normal volume.
REQ-009 (clinician, priority P1): The system shall support export to CSV with a 24-hour notice. Acceptance: covered by load tests at 10x normal volume.
REQ-010 (receptionist, priority P1): The system shall support multi-clinic accounts across all locations. Acceptance: reviewed by the privacy officer.
REQ-011 (patient, priority P1): The system shall support time-zone handling without data loss on reconnect. Acceptance: covered by load tests at 10x normal volume.
REQ-012 (clinician, priority P0): The system shall support offline mode without data loss on reconnect. Acceptance: reviewed by the privacy officer.
REQ-013 (receptionist, priority P2): The system shall support role-based permissions without data loss on reconnect. Acceptance: demonstrated to two pilot clinics.
REQ-014 (patient, priority P2): The system shall support recurring appointments with a 24-hour notice. Acceptance: demonstrated to two pilot clinics.
REQ-015 (clinician, priority P2): The system shall support double-booking prevention for up to 50 staff members. Acceptance: reviewed by the privacy officer.
REQ-016 (clinician, priority P0): The system shall support patient reminders by SMS within 2 seconds. Acceptance: demonstrated to two pilot clinics.
REQ-017 (patient, priority P0): The system shall support room and equipment booking within 2 seconds. Acceptance: reviewed by the privacy officer.
REQ-018 (patient, priority P0): The system shall support waiting list without data loss on reconnect. Acceptance: demonstrated to two pilot clinics.
REQ-019 (admin, priority P0): The system shall support cancellation policy without data loss on reconnect. Acceptance: reviewed by the privacy officer.
REQ-020 (patient, priority P1): The system shall support staff shift view for every action. Acceptance: verified by an end-to-end test.
REQ-021 (patient, priority P1): The system shall support audit log across all locations. Acceptance: demonstrated to two pilot clinics.
REQ-022 (clinician, priority P1): The system shall support export to CSV without data loss on reconnect. Acceptance: covered by load tests at 10x normal volume.
REQ-023 (admin, priority P2): The system shall support multi-clinic accounts within 2 seconds. Acceptance: reviewed by the privacy officer.
REQ-024 (admin, priority P2): The system shall support time-zone handling across all locations. Acceptance: reviewed by the privacy officer.
REQ-025 (admin, priority P2): The system shall support offline mode without data loss on reconnect. Acceptance: verified by an end-to-end test.
REQ-026 (patient, priority P1): The system shall support role-based permissions for up to 50 staff members. Acceptance: covered by load tests at 10x normal volume.


---

Turn these requirements into a test plan: group them, list concrete test cases and call out requirements that are ambiguous or conflicting.

Write a letter from a grandmother to her grandson on the morning he starts his first job.
Write a C function that reverses the order of words in a string in place, plus a main() that tests edge cases.
Write SQL CREATE TABLE plus 20 INSERT statements for a fictional hardware store inventory.
